==English==

===Etymology===
Late 19th c., from {{pre|en|de|accelerate|alt2=(ac)celerate}}. Compare ''[[deaccelerate]].''

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/diːˈsɛləɹeɪt/|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-decelerate.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To reduce the [[velocity]] of something.
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To reduce the [[rate]] of [[advancement]] of something, such as a [[disease]].
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To go [[slower]].

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|transitive|intransitive}} [[slow down]], [[slow]]
* {{sense|transitive|reduce the rate of advancement}} [[retard]]

====Antonyms====
* {{l|en|accelerate}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|undecelerated|decelerative|deceleron|deceleratingly
|deceleration
|decelerationism
|decelerator
}}
